subject: Mutual Action Plan: kickoff and stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@sprintlyhealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@sprintlyhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: kickoff and stakeholder alignment

Hi Aisha & Daniel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. As discussed, I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan to structure the evaluation and E2E close timeline. I’ve attached the draft (Sprintly-MAP-draft-v0.2.pdf).

Proposed next step: a 45-minute MAP kickoff to confirm: success criteria, stakeholder owners, evaluation tasks, and a target close date. Please confirm which of these two windows works for your team:

- Wed Jun 9, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Jun 10, 14:00–14:45 PT

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Review MAP objectives and target close date (10m)
3) Evaluation plan & responsibilities (15m)
4) Technical validation plan & access needs (10m)
5) Q&A / next steps (5m)

Requested attendees from your side: product/ML lead, security/compliance contact, and procurement (if you expect contract/PO discussions during evaluation). From our side I’ll bring Markus (solutions architect) and Monica (customer success).

If neither time works, propose two alternatives and I’ll send a calendar hold + Zoom. Also flag any additional artifacts you want included in the kickoff packet.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: kickoff and stakeholder alignment

Camila — thanks for pulling this together and for the clear agenda. Thu Jun 10, 14:00 PT works best for us.

Attendees from Sprintly: myself (Product), Daniel (ML), Lina Ortiz (Security) — I copied procurement as a placeholder; they may join the kickoff or jump in on contracting threads after the evaluation scope is finalized.

A couple quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you add a proposed target close date in the MAP doc? We want to align on internal timelines.
- For technical validation, can you include example dataset/ingestion steps so our ML team can pre-check access requirements?

If you can share the Zoom link and calendar invite, we’ll confirm the Lina/Procurement availability there.

Best,
Aisha
